edges = [(1,10), (4,10), (7,10), (1,6), (5,13), (3,6), (0,6), (0,15), (9,13), (3,12), (2,7), (4,14), (1,12), (8,13), (11,14), (5,12), (4,12), (5,14), (0,4), (6,7), (8,9), (9,12), (2,8), (10,14)]

import networkx as nx
import random

edges = [(1,10), (4,10), (7,10), (1,6), (5,13), (3,6), (0,6), (0,15), (9,13), (3,12), (2,7), (4,14), (1,12), (8,13), (11,14), (5,12), (4,12), (5,14), (0,4), (6,7), (8,9), (9,12), (2,8), (10,14)]

G = nx.Graph()
G.add_nodes_from(range(16))
G.add_edges_from(edges)

# Add edges to make minimum degree 5
for i in range(16):
    while G.degree(i) < 5:
        j = random.randint(0, 15)
        if i != j and not G.has_edge(i, j):
            G.add_edge(i, j)

while nx.node_connectivity(G) < 5:
    i = random.randint(0, 15)
    j = random.randint(0, 15)
    if i != j and not G.has_edge(i, j):
        G.add_edge(i, j)

print(nx.node_connectivity(G))
ans = []
for u, v in G.edges():
    if u > v:
        u, v = v, u
    ans.extend([u, v])
print(ans)
